How do I get from Beijing Capital Airpor.text: How do I get from Beijing Capital Airport to the city center? | travelchina.example The Airport Express line runs from Terminal 3 to Dongzhimen in about 25 minutes; taxis take 40-60 minutes depending on traffic.

Which apps do I need for a trip to China.text: Which apps do I need for a trip to China? | travelchina.example Most visitors install a map app, a ride-hailing app, a mobile payment app and a translation app before arrival.
